surface_mechanism_description: The impurities H, O and C are not incorporated in an atomic state but in the special radicals such as N–Hx, CHx, OHx and SiHx. These radicals dissociate as annealing, and then H is removed almost totally. The appearance of SiHx groups is attributed to the reactions between the residual NHx and the substrate Si. The dissociation process results in mass immigration.
